slots.tickets:
- #11 Add and list entries - labels: ready-for-agent - blocked by: none - full text: `{fixtures}/tickets/11.md`
  Criteria:
    1. `quill add "Shipped the export"` appends one entry to the journal file and exits 0
    2. `quill add` with no text prints usage to standard error and exits 1
    3. `quill list` prints one line per entry, newest first, as `<time>  <text>` (two spaces)
- #12 Export entries as CSV - labels: ready-for-agent - blocked by: #11 - full text: `{fixtures}/tickets/12.md`
  Criteria:
    1. `quill export` prints a header row `time,text` then one row per entry, oldest first
    2. A comma or quote in an entry's text is quoted as RFC 4180 requires
    3. `quill export` exits 3 with a message on standard error when the journal file does not exist
- #13 Back up the journal to Dropbox - labels: ready-for-agent - blocked by: #11 - full text: `{fixtures}/tickets/13.md`
  Criteria:
    1. `quill backup` uploads the journal file to `/Apps/quill/journal.jsonl` and prints the uploaded file's revision
    2. `quill backup` with `QUILL_DROPBOX_KEY` unset exits 1 with a message on standard error
    3. `quill backup` exits 3 with a message on standard error when the journal file does not exist
